name: ExpeL
what_evolved: Context (memory & prompts); no parametric/weight updates. Extracted insights and retrieved successful trajectories are injected into the agent prompt at inference.
skill_as_artifact: Yes. Two reusable artifact forms: (1) a set of natural-language insights/rules each carrying an importance count, and (2) a pool of successful trajectories stored in a vector DB for later recall.
skill_encoding: Natural language (NL insights/rules + NL trajectory transcripts). No executable code or learned embeddings used as the skill itself (embeddings only used for retrieval).
skill_granularity: Mixed: cross-task insights (policy rules/best practices) + sub-task workflows (full successful trajectories reused as few-shot demonstrations).
how_method: rollout_optimization (non-gradient, text-space insight abstraction) combined with imitation_demonstration (retrieved self-generated successful trajectories as in-context demos) and self-reflection (Reflexion) during experience gathering. [uncertain]
learning_signal_source: Success and failure trajectories from the agent's own trials (outcome of environment interaction) plus LLM self-reflection on failed attempts.
reward_granularity: outcome (binary task success/failure per trajectory; WebShop also uses a continuous reward score r in [0,1]).
learning_paradigm: Offline (two-stage: gather experiences then extract insights before evaluation); off-policy-like (learns from a stored experience pool gathered by a behavior policy). [uncertain]
when_evolve: inter-test-time (offline learning between training and evaluation tasks; explicitly contrasts with Reflexion's intra-task retries).
trigger: Task/curriculum driven (iterates over a collection of training tasks) plus failure-triggered reflection during gathering (self-reflect and retry up to Z times on failure).
library_structure: Hybrid: a Faiss vector store of successful trajectories + a flat list of insights with mutable importance counts (ADD/UPVOTE/DOWNVOTE/EDIT; insights pruned when count hits 0).
retrieval_method: Semantic similarity (task-similarity kNN over all-mpnet-base-v2 embeddings via Faiss) to fetch top-k successful trajectories as few-shot demos; the full insight list is concatenated directly into the task instruction (no retrieval of insights yet).
validation: Execution-based (environment success/failure labels trajectories) plus LLM-as-judge validation gating during insight extraction (the insight LLM UPVOTE/DOWNVOTE/EDIT operators and importance-count pruning filter low-quality insights).
error_correction: Self-revision via Reflexion-style reflection during gathering (re-attempt after failure); bounded edits to insights via the EDIT operator; emergent in-task self-correction (e.g., putting back a wrong object in ALFWorld).
test_env: HotpotQA (multi-hop QA), ALFWorld (text-based household embodied), WebShop (web shopping), FEVER (fact verification). All text-observation benchmarks.
backbone_model: GPT-3.5-turbo-0613 for action/policy and reflection; GPT-4-0613 for insight extraction (ablation shows GPT-4 > GPT-3.5 at insight extraction).
where_deploy: general (diverse decision-making/QA/tool-use domains); transfer-learning demo from HotpotQA (source) to FEVER (target).
metrics: success_rate (primary; exact-match for HotpotQA/FEVER, task completion for ALFWorld, full-attribute match for WebShop), mean reward for WebShop, per-task-type breakdown for ALFWorld, generalization/transfer, LLM API cost.
key_results: Consistently outperforms ReAct/Act baselines on HotpotQA, ALFWorld, WebShop (4-fold, mean +/- std error). Matches Reflexion R3 on HotpotQA (~39% vs 40%) and beats it on ALFWorld (59% vs 54%) without retries. Insights-only vs retrieve-only ablations are complementary/synergistic (e.g., HotpotQA 36%/31%, ALFWorld 50%/55%, WebShop 37%/38%). Positive forward transfer HotpotQA->FEVER. Reports emergent abilities: hypothesis formulation, world-model belief update, and self-correction.
limitations: scalability (insights fit current context window, but lifelong learning would need retrieval over insights), transferability (text-only observations; no image/VLM input), controllability (prompting-based, lacks theoretical underpinnings unlike RL), dependence on closed-source API LLMs (GPT-3.5/GPT-4), room for improvement on WebShop vs Reflexion.
